#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
layout_dir="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
mkdir -p "$layout_dir/logs"
layout_mode="${1:-check}"
layout_log="$layout_dir/logs/latest-entry-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-${layout_mode}-$$.log"
exec > >(tee -a "$layout_log") 2>&1
trap 'layout_exit=$?; trap - EXIT; printf "LAYOUT_EXIT=%s LOG=%s\n" "$layout_exit" "$layout_log"; exit "$layout_exit"' EXIT
layout_root="$(cd -- "${MAIN_DEV_ROOT:-$HOME/DEV}" && pwd -P)"
printf 'LAYOUT_START ROOT=%s MODE=%s LOG=%s\n' "$layout_root" "$layout_mode" "$layout_log"
python3 - "$layout_dir" <<'PYUNPACK'
import base64,hashlib,io,sys,stat,zipfile
from pathlib import Path,PurePosixPath
raw=base64.b64decode('')
if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!='f285619a8a47af76ccf68b2293a76a1249e84c62508d1db175908460cf61f12a':raise ValueError('Embedded archive hash differs')
folder=Path(sys.argv[1])/'latest-service-entry-r3'
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as z:
 if len(z.namelist())!=len(set(z.namelist())):raise ValueError('Duplicate archive paths')
 for info in z.infolist():
  path=PurePosixPath(info.filename)
  if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or '\\' in info.filename or stat.S_ISLNK(info.external_attr>>16):raise ValueError('Unsafe archive member')
  target=folder/str(path)
  if any(q.is_symlink() for q in (target,*target.parents)):raise ValueError('Symlink unpack path')
  data=z.read(info)
  if target.exists():
   if target.read_bytes()!=data:raise ValueError('Previously extracted file changed: '+str(path))
  else:
   target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
   with target.open('xb') as f:f.write(data)
print('EMBEDDED_ARCHIVE verified')
PYUNPACK
layout_bundle="$layout_dir/latest-service-entry-r3"
if [[ "$layout_mode" == gate ]]; then
 : "${GENOS_GENERATION:?Set exact serving generation absolute path, not an unfinished index folder}"
 python3 "$layout_bundle/apply.py" check --root "$layout_root" --payload "$layout_bundle/payload"
 python3 "$layout_root/06_TOOLS/COMMANDS/genos_release_gate.py" --code-zip "$layout_bundle/code.zip" --deploy-root "$layout_root" --generation "$GENOS_GENERATION"
else
 python3 "$layout_bundle/apply.py" "$layout_mode" --root "$layout_root" --payload "$layout_bundle/payload"
fi
